sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens were defeated handedly by the Jacksonville Jaguars on Thursday night, 33-10. It marked the team’s fourth straight loss and third consecutive defeat by 20+ points, representing a rock-bottom moment for the Ravens. Here are report card grades for Ravens’ position groups from another merciless loss in Week 9. Quarterback: F Joe Fagnano […]
